title: Prime Electron Caldera Synthesis - Ultimate Compendiums
description: Four ultimate compendiums representing the complete synthesis: ULTIMATE_COMPENDIUM (5.8 MB), ULTIMATE_COMPENDIUM_COMPLETE (18.9 MB), ULTIMATE_COMPENDIUM_AI (5.3 MB), ULTIMATE_COMPENDIUM_COMPLETE_AI (18.9 MB). Plus synthesis articles: Section 01 Pi×Axiomatic Foundation (106 KB + intros), Section 11 Unified Synthesis (110 KB + intros), Section 12 Mathematical Compendium (124 KB + intros). These represent the full integration of SubAtomic Prime Electron Canonical with Caldera Prime Pi Electron.
